_anchors.frames.walk: 8, forced by the flap's four named phases — the quarter marks must land on frames. This is the whole reason the flock cannot share aloft.json's 1: a frame count lives in the tunables, the cat-tuck rule.
_anchors.gait.swing: 0.1, unused: the flap is scaleY and y, never angle.
_anchors.gait.lift: 1.6 px: each bird breathes ±0.5 px around its slot. More and the flock's collision top would owe the runtime an honesty margin it does not have.
_anchors.gait.roll: 0. Birds do not roll; the channel belongs to the machine.
_anchors.body.scale: 1: the flock is drawn at the world's own scale, as all furniture.
_anchors.texture.dither: 0, the body rule from the skate round.
_anchors.fill.x: 0.45, opposite the key, the scene's fill.
_anchors.playback.msPerFrame: 105: eight frames make an 840 ms wingbeat cycle, about what a large bird actually beats; the obstacle animates on the page clock, not on distance, because a bird's wings owe nothing to the plane's speed.
_anchors.outline.inner: true; each bird is welded into one mark.
